prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 员工花名册 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "工号" · longest unbreakable word 59px · one-line width 59px
  col 2: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 70px
  col 3: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 87px
  col 4: header "职级" · longest unbreakable word 21px · one-line width 35px
  col 5: header "入职日期" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 94px
  col 6: header "主要职责" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 555px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 503px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 502px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"供读者查阅员工身份、所属部门、职级、入职日期和主要职责。","reading":"读者可先按工号或姓名定位员工，再横向读取其部门、职级、日期和职责；也可纵向比较部门、职级和入职日期。职责较长，预计会决定多数行的高度，其他字段的适度换行可利用这些行高。","groups":["工号与姓名共同标识员工。","部门与职级共同描述员工的组织位置。","入职日期是便于纵向比较的时间字段。","主要职责是解释员工工作内容的长文本字段。"],"keep_intact":["工号应保持完整单行。","职级应保持完整单行。","入职日期宜保持完整单行，方便比较。","姓名应尽可能保持完整，避免在姓名中间断行。"],"may_wrap":["主要职责可按中文语义自然换行。","部门名称可在必要时换行，并利用职责文本形成的行高。","空间紧张时姓名可换行，但应尽量避免。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [80, 73, 57, 56, 115, 121] · table 503×738px · row heights [39, 197, 92, 145, 171, 92] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [80, 73, 73, 56, 115, 105] · table 503×817px · row heights [39, 224, 66, 197, 224, 66] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [80, 91, 57, 56, 98, 120] · table 503×738px · row heights [39, 197, 92, 145, 171, 92] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"工号、职级和日期保持单行，表头清晰；职责列比 r2B 宽，长职责的阅读节奏较顺。","problems":"最长姓名断成两行，部门多次断成三行，削弱了身份和组织信息的整体性；职责仍较窄，长句被切成许多短行。","cause":"姓名列 73px 不能容纳最长姓名；部门列 57px 只能容纳约两个汉字；职责列 121px 在保留其他字段宽度后仍受限。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"工号、职级和日期完整单行；部门比 r2A 更容易按词组阅读，通常只需两行。","problems":"最长姓名仍然断行；职责列过窄，长句被切成零碎短行，部分行明显拉高，纵向浏览负担较重。","cause":"部门列增至 73px 挤占了职责列，使其降至 105px；姓名列仍为 73px。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"姓名完整单行，工号和职级也保持完整；职责列与 r2A 接近，整体行高相同。","problems":"所有日期都在连字符后断行，年月日不易作为一个整体识别和纵向比较；部门仍多次断成三行。","cause":"姓名列增至 91px 的空间主要来自日期列，日期列 98px 不足以容纳完整日期；部门列仍为 57px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整姓名日期","widths":[80,89,55,56,115,107],"change":"将姓名列扩至容纳最长姓名的 89px，并恢复日期的单行宽度；部门缩至 55px，仍可容纳两个汉字，职责保留 107px。检验身份和日期完整后，职责的换行是否仍可接受。"},{"name":"职责优先","widths":[80,73,55,56,115,123],"change":"保留 r2A 的姓名取舍，将部门略收窄，把空间让给职责；日期继续单行。检验略宽的职责能否改善长句节奏，以及最长姓名换行是否仍是值得接受的代价。"}]}
